Q5217.reason: The specific catalog quote was accepted by the purchase order at $1,000 CIF, and CIF already obliges the seller to bear loading, so the later loading charge never changed the price.

Q6156.reason: The post-firing deposition is not a vicarious admission, and former testimony fails because the company had no similar opportunity to develop the strict-liability defect issue in the wrongful-termination suit.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the Grand Chamber upheld Kuwait’s civil state immunity and found no Article 6 violation, so immunity prevailed over the claimed right of access to court.
